snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3679750/Shrine_Protectors

A casual arrow shooter meets rogue-lite strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, unlock passive spells and upgrades, and return stronger after every battle. Combine precision shooting with tactical army management.
